newsitem.title: USA: ITT Industries unit ups stake in China unit.
newsitem.headline: ITT Industries unit ups stake in China unit.

text.p: ITT Cannon, a unit of ITT Industries' Defense & Electronics group, has increased ownership of its China-based connector manufacturing and assembly joint venture company from 51 percent to 90 percent, ITT said on Wednesday.
The joint venture company will continue to be known as ITT Cannon Electronics Co Ltd, the company said.
In addition, ITT Cannon president Gerry Gendron said the company anticipated that sales for the joint venture will grow more than twofold in 1997 compared with 1996 levels.

Located in Zhenjiang, China, ITT Cannon Electronics Co Ltd manufactures connectors for a variety of industries, including telecommunications, computer and medical applications. It currently serves 25 China-based customers.
